## Mova 1.5.0

Mova 1.5.0 优化了媒体库扫描与刮削流水线。远端 TMDB 元数据和图片准备现在以受控并发执行，数据库提交、图片发布、目录 revision 与权威扫描进度仍保持单协调器串行更新，从而在提升网络阶段吞吐的同时维持确定性和事务一致性。

本版本还减少了扫描期间重复的数据库查询、字幕目录遍历和 TMDB 请求，只为本地实际存在的季获取季集大纲，并增加有界缓存、同请求 single-flight、临时错误重试、结构化性能日志和可重复的容量测试。默认远端准备并发为 4，两段队列容量均为 2；该配置保留了多用户部署下的网络、内存和数据库余量。

本版本不修改公开 HTTP/SSE 契约，不包含数据库迁移，也不要求重建缓存或重新扫描媒体库。现有部署可直接升级。

---

## Mova 1.5.0

Mova 1.5.0 optimizes the media-library scanning and enrichment pipeline. Remote TMDB metadata and artwork preparation now run with bounded concurrency, while database commits, artwork publication, catalog revisions, and authoritative scan progress remain serialized through one coordinator. This improves network-stage throughput without weakening deterministic or transactional behavior.

The release also removes repeated database queries, subtitle-directory walks, and TMDB requests during scans; fetches episode outlines only for seasons present locally; and adds bounded caches, per-request single-flight, transient-error retries, structured performance telemetry, and a reproducible capacity model. The production default uses four remote preparation slots with queue capacity two on both sides, preserving network, memory, and database headroom for multi-user deployments.

This release does not change the public HTTP or SSE contract, contains no database migration, and requires no cache rebuild or media-library rescan. Existing deployments can upgrade in place.
